title: Space Typing Trainer
lead: Type the text: every correct key fires your ship's laser at the asteroid. The longer your streak without mistakes, the stronger the shots. No need to hurry, the asteroid will wait for you.
touchText: This trainer works with the physical keyboard of a computer or laptop. You can't type on a phone or tablet without a keyboard.
levelsHint: Levels unlock one by one: finish a level to open the next.
resetConfirm: Reset all trainer progress? This cannot be undone.
stageAria: Game screen: your ship is at the bottom left, an asteroid flies in from the top right. Mistakes bring the asteroid closer.
status.start: Type the text. Every correct key fires a shot, and a mistake brings the asteroid closer.
status.miss: Mistake. The asteroid is closer: {errors} of {max}.
status.missCombo: Mistake, combo lost. The asteroid is closer: {errors} of {max}.
hint.shift: Next: **{key}** (with Shift). Finger: {finger}; hold Shift with the {shiftFinger}.
result.wonText: The way is clear. See how you did.
result.lostText: The asteroid reached your ship. No worries: try again, and take your time.
